# Exceptions for scripts/secret_scan.py.
#
# One exemption per line. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored.
#
#   <substring>     a match whose VALUE contains this substring is accepted
#   path:<glob>     a whole path is accepted, matched against the tracked
#                   relative path with fnmatch (e.g. `path:tests/fixtures/*`)
#
# Both forms are greppable, so every acceptance is a visible decision and the
# reason lives in the line above it. The scanner never prints a value, so an
# entry here names the shape of what is accepted.
#
# This file is not itself scanned: it exists to hold the acceptances, and the
# scanner skips it and its own source.
#
# No entry is active today. The tracked tree passes `--all` with this list
# empty, so the first entry added should carry the finding it answers.
#
# The SEC-1 invariant test carries a synthetic credential corpus and the 20
# secret patterns the redactor must mask; every value is fabricated and the test
# asserts that none survives. Accepted as a fixture file, not as a leak.
path:tests/test_runtime_p0a.py
# RT-01Z2's publication log quotes the fixture lines above while recording that
# the public export carried them; the log is evidence of that scan.
# RT-01Z3's probes create a synthetic engine key and SSH key in a scratch HOME
# to prove the file-route refusal. The quoted blocks are fixtures.
